name: White County, IN
findings: White County has 84 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, White County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
